Life is full of small surprises. Last Thursday, Owen and David went to the family dinner. Owen's favorite animal is the elephant. Grandma cooks dinner for us.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the family dinner by bike. Owen borrowed a book about math from the zoo. Owen likes rainy days best.
